summary_en: Living Technologies will acquire up to 184,000 shares (7.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥460 million through market purchases and off-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 1, 2026 to September 22, 2027, to support stable shareholder returns via stock ownership benefits while pursuing business growth.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Living Technologies Inc. announced on September 29, 2026 that its Board of Directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 184,000 treasury shares, representing 7.8% of outstanding shares (2,364,084 shares as of the announcement date), for a maximum total of ¥460 million. The acquisition will be executed through market purchases and off-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from October 1, 2026 through September 22, 2027.

The company undertakes this buyback to support stable and sustainable implementation of its shareholder benefit program while advancing business growth. The program reflects management's commitment to balanced capital allocation between shareholder returns and operational expansion.

The company notes that depending on the progress of the buyback, it may face potential non-compliance with Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth market listing maintenance criteria (particularly regarding trading volume and float ratio). Should such non-compliance occur, the company intends to explore transition to a single listing on the Nagoya Stock Exchange Main Market, where it currently has a secondary listing.
